pr.title: Use cloud icon for Azure environment
pr.author: maddymontaquila

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: All three failing Blazor browser-debugger E2E tests time out (~260-300s) waiting for the Blazor WASM root debug session to attach. The PR only changes Azure environment icon code (src/Aspire.Hosting.Azure/AzureEnvironmentResourceExtensions.cs) and its tests, which is completely unrelated to the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM debugger E2E tests. This matches a well-known recurring flaky pattern (22 prior occurrences) for this exact test suite/job.
